author: GameTrailers
description: Mr. Sleepy Man is out now on Steam. Check out the Mr. Sleepy Man launch trailer for this adventure game. Mr. Sleepy Man is up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action.
title: Mr. Sleepy Man - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at gameplay from Sound System in this teaser trailer for the upcoming rhythm game. Sound System will be available on PC (Steam) on October 16, 2026.

Sound System revives the rhythm game genre with intense gameplay, built-in creator tools, and a community platform for artists and players to share music-driven creativity. Shred guitar, play bass, or sing vocals using keyboard, controller, compatible guitar controllers, or microphone. Enjoy local split-screen or online modes, including co-op band performances with shared multipliers and effects, and head-to-head competitive modes for stage control battles.

Sound System will launch with a diverse music catalog of 50+ songs mixing legendary covers, established indie artists, and rising new bands.
title: Sound System - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Legend of Mushroom x Palworld trailer for this crossover event between the idle RPG, Legend of Mushroom, and the open-word survival crafting game, Palworld. The limited-time event is out now, and celebrates Legend of Mushroom's second anniversary with an in-game carnival.

The crossover event introduces Palworld characters and Pals into Legend of Mushroom, including Chillet, Cattiva, Lamball, Daedream, Grizzbolt, the fearsome Faction Leader Zoe, and more. They will be available as limited-time Pals, Mounts, Costumes, or powerful Support Star Heroes. New gameplay updates will also be available, giving you a chance to build cozy homes for your pals in the Pal Paradise mode, along with collab mounts, Jetragon and Quivern. A new boss battle called Faction Leader Challenge will also be introduced.
title: Legend of Mushroom x Palworld - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at gameplay and more from RAD: Repeat After Death in this trailer for the upcoming action arcade platforming game where your actions become your own enemy. RAD: Repeat After Death will be available on PC on April 17, 2026.

Make your way through the various dungeons and kill the monster with your attacks. Repeat this over and over again until you clear the dungeon. Simple enough, right? But beware, as your actions from every character before will haunt you and be repeated back in your next. Dodge your way through the many ghosts of your own movement to kill the guardian and get out of this looping purgatory.
title: RAD: Repeat After Death - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Zero Stress King trailer for this upcoming short, relaxing incremental game disguised as a tower defense, but enemies can’t reach your walls. Thanks to lava. Zero Stress King will be available on PC on March 30, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Zero Stress King: Idle Defense - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Patch 1 Overview Trailer for No Rest for the Wicked, an action soulslike RPG developed by Moon Studios. Players can get the rundown on all of the new features and changes coming with Patch 1, including Duel Mode, Comfort System, Chat System, a Realm Diary, and more. Patch 1 launches on March 18 for No Rest for the Wicked, available now in Early Access for PC (Steam), with an eventual release on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: No Rest for the Wicked - Official Patch 1 Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2: Showdown cinematic recap trailer to catch up on events ahead of the new season. Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2: Showdown begins on March 19, 2026.
title: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2: Showdown - Official Cinematic Recap Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at the terrifying enemies, unsettling world, and combat of Grime 2 in this new trailer for the upcoming action-adventure metroidvania sequel to the 2021 game. Grime 2 will be avaialble on PC (Steam), Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on March 31, 2026.

In Grime 2, become a stealer of forms. You are a Formless - an art mimic, absorbing creatures and summoning molds in their shape.

Venture into a new and mysterious land in the Grime universe, where danger and wonder await around every corner. Use your surroundings in tandem with your summoned molds to overcome deadly enemies and epic bosses, all the while exploring a deep world full of diverse cultures and characters.
title: Grime 2 - Official Console Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Launch Trailer for MLB The Show 26, the latest installment in the baseball simulation franchise developed by Sony San Diego. Players will take up America's favorite pastime with new features, enhancements, and more. MLB The Show 26 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: MLB The Show 26 - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains teaser trailer for this dynamic, team-based twist on the classic Monopoly experience. Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 1, Nintendo Switch 2, and GeForce Now, as well as Windows PC through the Ubisoft Store, Epic Games Store, and Steam on June 11, 2026. A full reveal will be available on April 29, 2026.

Developed by Behavior Interactive, Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains transports players into the Star Wars galaxy with a custom Monopoly board packed with iconic locations from across the saga. Classic Monopoly gameplay is reimagined with thrilling cinematic moments, themed spaces, and dynamic elements. You can choose from a wide roster of Star Wars heroes and villains, from Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia to Darth Vader and Darth Maul. Each character brings unique abilities that shape your team’s strategy and can turn the tide in your favor wit
title: Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the White Fox Character Reveal Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based free-to-play hero shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players will be able to fight as White Fox with Season 7, a legendary nine-tailed fox and Director of Tiger Division. White Fox is armed with fierce claw projectiles, area of effect attacks, and an ultimate that transforms her into a powerful fox to even the playing field. Play as White Fox with Season 7 of Marvel Rivels, launching on March 20 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#MarvelRivals #Gaming #IGN
title: Marvel Rivals - Official White Fox Character Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Launch Trailer for Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War!, a first-person action boomer shooter developed by Auroch Digital. Players will take on a variety of powerful bugs on hostile planets in the Starship Troopers universe. Do your part and fight for the Federation in Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War!, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and GoG).

#StarshipTroopersUltimateBugWar #Gaming #IGN
title: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a deep dive into Satisfactory's Update 1.2 for the first-person open-world factory building game, which brings spawn toilets, allowing you to set a respawn point anywhere in the game's world. Additional features in Update 1.2 include vehicle pathing improvements, fluid trucks and stations, weather systems, node randomization, which is a game mode that allows for resource node randomization with five presets, and quality-of-life updates. Satisfactory's Update 1.2 is currently available to play in the Experimental branch on Steam and Epic Games Store, with an official release coming later in 2026.
title: Satisfactory - Official Update 1.2 Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Console Announcement Trailer for Momento, a cozy room decorating game developed by Fat Alien Cat and Nomo Studio. Players will decorate their room throughout their lifetime, with select items being kept in the room changing the course of the lifetime itslef. Momento is coming soon to PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Momento - Official Console Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Ratline is out now on Steam via PC and Mac. Watch The Ratline launch trailer for this detective thriller game. A murdered priest. A secret list. Hunt Nazi fugitives across the globe in this gritty 1971 detective thriller. Analyze evidence, follow leads, and make sharp deductions before the trail goes cold. From the creators of Family, Rivals, Conspiracy, Echo Beach and Riley & Rochelle.

#TheRatline #Gaming #IGN
title: The Ratline - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Console Launch Trailer for Dread Delusion, an open-world dark fantasy RPG adventure game developed by Lovely Hellplace. Players will explore diverse and shattered lands to take up the art of magic. Complete different quests, engage in combat, and harness forbidden knowledge. Dread Delusion is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

#DreadDelusion #Gaming #IGN
title: Dread Delusion - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Fresco, a first-person puzzle adventure game developed by Kelonia Games. Players will explore the temple walls of ancient Egypt by switching off between a 3D archaeologist observing the mysteries of the temple and a 2D fresco character that comes to life. Solve puzzles, manipulate the environment, and make use of both perspectives to progress. Fresco is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Fresco - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Season 7 Dev Vision Vol. 15 for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based free-to-play hero shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players can hear straight from the development team on the upcoming changes and additions being made to the game with Season 7, including the introduction of White Fox and Black Cat, a new Convergence map, perks for College Students, adjustments to Team-Ups, and more. Season 7 for Marvel Rivals kicks off on March 20 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Season 7 Dev Vision Vol. 15

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer for Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club, a mystery detective adventure game developed by Cradle Games. Players will accompany Snoopy and company to solve a deep and winding mystery. Explore the town, solve puzzles, and make sense of clues to solve the case. Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club is available now for Nintendo Switch 2 alongside PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Lucky Tower Ultimate, a dungeon-crawling action roguelike developed by Studio Seufz. Players will take on a suite of enemies in procedurally generated towers in comedic fashion. Take down Evelius in Lucky Tower Ultimate, launching on April 16 for Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Lucky Tower Ultimate - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date for Tamashika, a stylized first-person arcade shooter developed by Quicktequila. Players must focus to achieve victory as abstract patterns and vibrant colors beckon those who are up for the ultimate challenge. Walk, strafe, parry, and more to progress from level to level with no checkpoints. Tamashika is launching on April 10 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Tamashika - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Noko's Noodles, a cyberpunk noodle shop management game developed by Cyclogon. Players will lead operations of a dark cyberpunk noodle shop to make noodles, facilitate connections with clientele, and choose how to respond that could change the course of the world. Noko's Noodles is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Noko's Noodles - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the March 2026 Update Trailer for Payday 3, the hit tactical first-person heist shooter developed by Starbreeze Studios. Players will be able to access new features with the latest update to the game, such as damage numbers, the first version of the Contract system, and fat cops to combat with. The March 2026 Update for Payday 3 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Payday 3 - Official March 2026 Update Trailer
